displayName: OCI-WSTG01-015: Debug Mode and Test Endpoints Exposed
description:
Detects access to debug endpoints, test pages, or development tools left in production

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: debug mode and test endpoints exposed

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_015", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%debug%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%mode%') AND "value" > 0
